title: Managing Optional Extensions in Business Central AL Code
summary: This post explains how to create a single Business Central extension that optionally interacts with a third-party extension without creating a hard dependency. The technique uses NavApp.GetModuleInfo to detect if an optional extension is installed, then uses RecordRef and FieldRef to conditionally set extension-specific fields.
key_points: Call NavApp.GetModuleInfo with the optional extension's app ID to find out at runtime whether it is installed
Split the journal creation into a core insert and a separate step for the fields from the optional extension
Use RecordRef and FieldRef with field numbers taken from page inspection to set those fields without a dependency
Check that each FieldRef is active before giving it a value, then modify the record through the RecordRef
With no dependency declared in app.json, one app runs on systems with or without the third-party extension
